facts.text: Spring Term is tuition-free to students who were enrolled full-time (day division) during Semesters I and II immediately prior to Spring Term, have no unpaid balance with the university, and have never taken a Spring Term course in the past.

sources.title: Spring Term Information | UIndy
sources.quote: Spring Term is tuition-free to students who were enrolled full-time (day division) during Semesters I and II immediately prior to Spring Term, have no unpaid balance with the University, and have never taken a Spring Term course in the past.

facts.text: At UIndy, 21st Century Scholars with maximum need may receive the Momentum Award that, in combination with federal and state grant aid, is equal to full tuition, requiring a GPA of 2.7 or higher.
